site.name: Real Local Tools
site.title: Real Local Tools — free tools that run entirely in your browser
site.description: A growing collection of free online tools for developers, designers and everyone else. No uploads, no signups, no tracking — every tool runs locally in your browser.
site.tagline: No uploads. No signups. No tracking. Every tool runs entirely in your browser — they even work offline.

hero.eyebrow: No upload · No signup · No tracking
hero.title: Tools that never leave your browser
hero.subtitle: Fast, free utilities for developers and everyday work — processed 100% locally on your device. Pull the plug and they still work.

footer.tagline: Your data never leaves your device.
footer.note: A fully static site with zero servers and zero trackers.

json-formatter.name: JSON Formatter & Validator
json-formatter.description: Format, validate, beautify or minify JSON instantly — right in your browser.
json-formatter.seoTitle: JSON Formatter & Validator — free, local, no upload
json-formatter.seo: Paste any JSON and get it formatted with your choice of indentation, minified for production, or validated with precise error positions. The parsing uses your browser's own JSON engine, so even sensitive payloads stay on your device.

base64-converter.name: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
base64-converter.description: Convert text to Base64 and back, with full Unicode support — all in your browser.
base64-converter.seoTitle: Base64 Encoder & Decoder — Unicode-safe, runs locally
base64-converter.seo: Encode plain text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to readable text. Unlike naive converters, this tool handles the full Unicode range correctly — Chinese characters, emoji and accented letters all survive the round trip. Conversion happens entirely in your browser.

ui.invalid: That doesn't look like valid Base64.

password-generator.name: Password Generator
password-generator.description: Generate strong random passwords with your browser's crypto engine — nothing is sent anywhere.
password-generator.seo: Passwords are generated with crypto.getRandomValues(), the same cryptographically secure random source browsers use for TLS keys. Choose length and character sets, watch the entropy estimate update in real time, and copy with one click. The password never leaves this page.

ui.needOne: Select at least one character set.
ui.placeholder: Click regenerate to create a password

url-converter.name: URL Encoder / Decoder
url-converter.description: Encode and decode URLs and URI components safely — instantly, in your browser.
url-converter.seoTitle: URL Encoder & Decoder — free, runs locally
url-converter.seo: Encode special characters so they survive inside URLs and query parameters, or decode percent-encoded strings back to readable text. Choose component mode for parameter values or full-URL mode for whole links. Everything runs locally in your browser.

ui.inputPlaceholder: Type or paste text, or a percent-encoded string…
ui.invalid: That doesn't look like a percent-encoded string.

uuid-generator.name: UUID Generator
uuid-generator.description: Generate random v4 UUIDs in bulk — cryptographically random, right in your browser.
uuid-generator.seoTitle: UUID / GUID Generator — bulk v4, cryptographically random
uuid-generator.seo: Generate up to 100 RFC 4122 version-4 UUIDs with one click, using your browser's cryptographically secure random source. Toggle uppercase or remove dashes, then copy them all. Nothing is sent anywhere.

timestamp-converter.name: Unix Timestamp Converter
timestamp-converter.description: Convert Unix epoch timestamps to human-readable dates and back — with live current time.
timestamp-converter.seoTitle: Unix Timestamp Converter — epoch to date, local & UTC
timestamp-converter.seo: Paste a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds — auto-detected) to see the corresponding date in your local timezone and UTC, or pick a date to get its timestamp. A live clock shows the current epoch time. All conversion happens in your browser.

html-entity-converter.name: HTML Entity Encoder / Decoder
html-entity-converter.description: Encode special characters to HTML entities and decode them back — safe for pasting code into pages.
html-entity-converter.seoTitle: HTML Entity Encoder & Decoder — runs locally
html-entity-converter.seo: Convert characters like <, >, & and quotes into their HTML entity equivalents so code snippets render safely in web pages, or decode entities back to plain text. Named entities are used where they exist. Runs entirely in your browser.

color-converter.name: Color Converter
color-converter.description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL — with a visual picker and one-click copy.
color-converter.seoTitle: Color Converter — HEX, RGB, HSL with visual picker
color-converter.seo: Pick a color visually or paste a HEX, RGB or HSL value and see every format update in sync. Copy any representation with one click for your CSS. Everything runs locally.

number-base-converter.name: Number Base Converter
number-base-converter.description: Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal and any base from 2 to 36.
number-base-converter.seoTitle: Number Base Converter — binary, octal, hex, base 2-36
number-base-converter.seo: Enter a number in any base from 2 to 36 and instantly see it in binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal. Big values are supported exactly thanks to arbitrary-precision integers. Runs entirely in your browser.

ui.invalid: Invalid digits for the selected base

word-counter.name: Word & Character Counter
word-counter.description: Count characters, words, sentences and paragraphs in real time — with reading time estimate.
word-counter.seoTitle: Word & Character Counter — real-time text statistics
word-counter.seo: Paste or type text and watch the counts update instantly: characters with and without spaces, words, sentences, paragraphs and lines, plus an estimated reading time. Counting rules work for both English and Chinese text. Everything stays in your browser.

ui.placeholder: Start typing or paste your text…

case-converter.name: Case Converter
case-converter.description: Convert text between lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case and more.
case-converter.seoTitle: Case Converter — camelCase, snake_case, Title Case & more
case-converter.seo: One click converts your text to lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case or kebab-case. Handy when moving between code conventions and prose. Runs locally in your browser.

text-reverser.name: Text Reverser
text-reverser.description: Reverse text character by character, word by word, or line by line — instantly.
text-reverser.seoTitle: Text Reverser — flip characters, words or lines
text-reverser.seo: Flip your text three ways: reverse every character, reverse the order of words, or reverse the order of lines. Unicode-aware, so emoji and accented characters stay intact. Everything runs locally.

remove-duplicate-lines.name: Remove Duplicate Lines
remove-duplicate-lines.description: Deduplicate lines, strip blank lines and sort — with a live count of what was removed.
remove-duplicate-lines.seoTitle: Remove Duplicate Lines — dedupe, sort & strip blanks
remove-duplicate-lines.seo: Paste line-separated text and remove duplicate lines while keeping the original order, or sort the result alphabetically. Blank lines can be stripped too, and a live summary shows how many lines were removed. Runs entirely in your browser.

percentage-calculator.name: Percentage Calculator
percentage-calculator.description: Three everyday percentage questions, answered instantly: X% of Y, X is what % of Y, and % change.
percentage-calculator.seoTitle: Percentage Calculator — percent of, is what %, % change
percentage-calculator.seo: Answer the three percentage questions that come up all the time: What is X% of Y? X is what percent of Y? What is the percentage change from X to Y? Results update as you type. Runs locally in your browser.

bmi-calculator.name: BMI Calculator
bmi-calculator.description: Calculate your Body Mass Index in metric or imperial units, with WHO category feedback.
bmi-calculator.seoTitle: BMI Calculator — metric & imperial, WHO categories
bmi-calculator.seo: Enter your height and weight in metric or imperial units and get your BMI instantly, along with the WHO weight category it falls into and the healthy weight range for your height. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.

date-difference.name: Date Difference Calculator
date-difference.description: Calculate the exact difference between two dates in days, weeks, months and years — plus business days.
date-difference.seoTitle: Date Difference Calculator — days, weeks, business days
date-difference.seo: Pick two dates and see the exact gap expressed in days, weeks, months and years, including a business-day count that skips weekends. The end date can be included or excluded. Everything runs in your browser.

random-number-generator.name: Random Number Generator
random-number-generator.description: Generate random numbers in any range — unique or repeatable, one or in bulk.
random-number-generator.seoTitle: Random Number Generator — any range, unique picks
random-number-generator.seo: Pick a minimum and maximum, choose how many numbers you want, and optionally require them to be unique or sorted. Generation uses your browser's cryptographically secure random source. Runs entirely offline.

ui.invalid: Can't pick that many unique values from this range
